scope: Live NCCP PDF source reconciliation for seven related breast regimens. Research audit only; no clinical authorisation or independent human validation. No application files edited.
method: Downloaded all seven PDFs from existing official HSE metadata URLs using Mozilla user agent; SHA256 retained.
Read extracted text in full; visually checked decision tables where glyphs, overlapping ranges or row scope might be lost.
Official web open independently resolved each mapped PDF. Public search coverage was poor; known current HSE breast catalogue also fetched for link verification.
Compared complete existing protocol inputs, phase structures and executable rules. Proposed cases are source-derived acceptance cases, not executed tests.
global_integrity_requirements: Preserve each regimen-specific difference: component overlap does not make numerical thresholds interchangeable.

All fields optional. Evaluate any independently actionable supplied value. Missing phase/context must yield explicitly conditional component results or request for phase review, never assume AC or paclitaxel or maintenance.
A normal supplied value is only assessed for its domain; missing values remain unassessed and cannot authorise treatment.
Use absolute bilirubin micromol/L for doxorubicin tables and ALT/bilirubin ULN ratios for paclitaxel tables. Do not substitute eGFR for source CrCl without identified clinical calculation.
Do not apply cytotoxic haematology dose reductions to trastuzumab maintenance; trastuzumab tables explicitly allow continuation during reversible chemotherapy myelosuppression with monitoring.
Separate source-listed baseline eligibility from later-cycle thresholds and distinguish current febrile neutropenia emergency from history driving next-cycle reduction.
Show source ambiguity or gap visibly and require consultant/pharmacy interpretation; do not silently round decimal values or inherit thresholds from a different protocol.

Routine CT/TAP, tumour markers, DEXA and a universal post-therapy scan schedule are not specified in these regimen PDFs. A longitudinal map must label any supplemental guideline schedule and context separately.
RT timing after cytotoxic chemotherapy is explicit for 00252. Other PDFs do not prescribe a full surgery/radiation/endocrine sequence; do not assert an exact additional sequence as an NCCP statement.
